data.body:
F12 verification disposition.

An isolated current-main run of test_resign_routes_through_pin_collecting_sign_path passed. Pytest recorded 201.81 seconds in the call, 5.15 seconds in setup, and 0.06 seconds in teardown, while total process time was 524.52 seconds. A process sample during the post-PASS interval showed recursive temporary-tree deletion dominated by unlinkat and rmdir.

Created bug anatomical-continuous-akitainu and linked it to F12 plus the four relevant timeout and cleanup histories. Its diagnostic plan passed with no blockers. The signature could not persist because unrelated ticket commits changed the store generation during every attempt. Active bug georgiaite-flawless-sawfish owns that signing defect and has not landed a repair. No force option was used, and the new bug remains open and unclaimed. No further investigation will occur under it until the claim gate can be satisfied.

Current main now includes aa0668b0ee3, which removes timeout_func_only and bounds fixture phases. The F12 ticket has five focused verification entries and does not require the full suite locally. F12 work will continue on current main. Gerrit CI will run the repository suite before the change can merge.
